summary: ```markdown # Marvelous Designer Tips Sharing [Clothing Details Edition] ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will explore various techniques in Marvelous Designer, focusing on handling clothing and model interpenetration issues, pressure settings, and applications. ## Creating Positive Circles To create a positive circle: 1. Change to the round tool in the salad menu. 2. Press the Shift key and click and drag the mouse button in the 2D window. ## Viewing Surface Sides To see the positive and negative sides of the surface: 1. Switch to the physical surface, which is the single layer display. 2. After selecting the version, select the outer layer of the column in the menu bar. 3. Create a version that is identical and interactive with it. ## Creating New Versions To create a new version: 1. Select both versions simultaneously. 2. Press the Shift key and drag the mouse button in the 2D window. ## Board Arrangement The boards can be arranged at 45 degrees or 90 degrees for better visibility of the positive and negative sides. ## Applying Positive and Negative Pressure When applying pressure: - A positive number applies a horizontal force from the back to the positive side. - A negative number applies a horizontal force from the front to the back. ### Simulation of Round-Shaped Pillow After opening the simulation, you will see that the round-shaped pillow is complete. Changing the bottom of the board to positive pressure results in both boards receiving the force from the back to the positive side, causing a force imbalance. ### Balancing Pressure Values For balance: - The pressure values must be the same when two boards face each other. - The pressure of the board facing the front must be positive, while the back must be negative. ### Observing Pressure Effects When both boards face each other on the front, the pressure needs to be set to positive. The effects of pressure become more pronounced with higher values. The physical property will also affect the air supply effect. ## Practical Use of Pressure in Sleeves Now, let's take a look at how to make a sleeve pop up: 1. Use a separate plate facing outside. 2. Apply positive pressure to make the sleeve pop up. ### Adjusting Elastic Strength If the elastic strength of the sleeve material is too high, reduce it to make the pressure more apparent. ## Sewing Plates with Elastic Strength When sewing a wide plate onto a narrow plate: - Apply elastic strength to the shorter side. - Set the elastic strength value to 100 to observe the pressure dynamics. ### Effects of Elastic Strength Without elastic strength, the sewing line will pull both sides together, stretching the short side. With elastic strength applied, the side will remain taut, making the pressure effects more pronounced. ## Applying Pressure to Skirts When applying positive pressure to a skirt: - The skirt gradually expands and may float in the air. - Changing the pressure value to 2 makes the skirt looser. ### Observing Cooling Effects During the cooling process, pulls may appear if the pressure is not transmitted correctly, but the skirt retains some looseness. ## Using Negative Pressure After finishing the edge of the contract: - Modify the pressure to a negative value to bring the edge closer to the model. ## Creating an Inflatable T-Shirt 1. Use the internal line tool to draw and copy an internal line. 2. Align the internal line to the outer line of the panel to finish the air line for the t-shirt. ### Cutting Layers for Inflatable Effect Cut a layer to create the inflatable effect. Ensure: - The inner line on the panel forms an inflatable line. - Set the inner panel pressure to negative and the outer panel to positive. ### Adjusting Simulation Values After opening the simulation: - If the effect is not obvious, increase the vertical and horizontal values to 10. - Reducing the tension of the diagonal line makes the clothing appear fluffier. ### Final Adjustments Change the elasticity of the clothing to 98 to enhance the inflatable effect. If the inflatable effect is not prominent, increase the strength of the gold-plated gauze and reduce the particle diameter for detailed wrinkles. ## Conclusion Thank you for joining this session on Marvelous Designer tips. See you in the next video! ```
